summary: # Advanced Cloud Pentesting Scripts Reference: [Cloud Pentesting Cheatsheet by Beau Bullock](https://github.com/dafthack/CloudPentestCheatsheets) ## Scope and handling The all-subscription loops below are templates, not permission to broaden the engagement. Replace discovery with an explicit authorized subscription/resource allowlist and private output directory. Runbooks, job output, function settings and ScoutSuite exports may contain secrets; redact before reporting. Service-principal resets, new users and role assignments can break access or create persistence: document a path without executing it unless a separate lab mutation plan and cleanup are approved.
